notes: Keep-alive Phase 1 dataset. IMPORTANT: marketplaces (AppSumo, StackSocial) were checked 2026-10-06 and publish no inactivity requirement; inactivity rules are set by each software vendor. Marketplace entries therefore carry Perpetua's conservative default reminder window, not a marketplace policy. Verify with the product vendor. confidence: high = vendor-published number; medium = vendor-published but ambiguous; low = Perpetua default / unverified.
